mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (computed as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the last 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL: when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL is above 3.0%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining and housing starts (HOUST) are below 1800.0, it signals a weakening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0 and HOUST < 1800.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDPC1 > 11400.0 and RSAFS > 360000.0), the strong demand indicators signal overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 11400.0 and RSAFS > 360000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between labor market strength (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO): when PAYEMS is rising and INDPRO is below 110.0, it signals a strong labor market that may lead to wage pressures and supply chain disruptions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 135000.0 and INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
